cad.title: Helical Gear
cad.subtitle: Parametric helical gear with a true involute tooth profile
cad.description: A fully parametric helical gear modelled from first principles, driven by module, helix angle and tooth count so the geometry updates automatically as the design changes.
cad.problem: Standard SolidWorks toolbox gears don't expose the underlying involute geometry, making it hard to customise tooth profile, helix angle or backlash for a non-standard application.
cad.solution: Built the involute tooth profile from equations driven by module and pressure angle, then used a helical sweep to generate the full tooth geometry, with every parameter (module, teeth, helix angle, face width) exposed for reuse in future gear designs.

cad.title: PCB Enclosure
cad.subtitle: Custom-fit enclosure design for a PCB assembly
cad.description: A snap-fit enclosure designed around a specific PCB's mounting holes, connectors and component heights, built for FDM 3D printing.
cad.problem: Off-the-shelf enclosures rarely line up with a custom PCB's mounting holes, port cutouts and component clearances, leading to a messy final assembly.
cad.solution: Modelled the enclosure directly around the PCB's outline, standoffs and connector positions, with wall thickness and snap-fit tabs sized for reliable FDM 3D printing.
